title: PostToolUse Hook Input
description: JSON piped to stdin for PostToolUse hooks (Bash). Derived from detect-loop.sh field access patterns (grep/sed, no Python).

tool_name.description: Name of the tool that was invoked (e.g., Bash)

command.description: The bash command that was executed. Parsed by detect-loop.sh via grep.

stdout.description: Standard output from the tool execution

stderr.description: Standard error from the tool execution

exit_code.description: Exit code of the tool execution. Parsed by detect-loop.sh via grep.
